situation_facts: The Threadneedle corridor extension application was submitted to the regulator on 11 July.
The regulator's published median decision time for corridor extensions is ninety working days.
No written decision, conditional approval, or reference to a decision has been received.
The regulator's case portal showed the status as under assessment when Marisol checked it on 3 December.
On 1 December a colleague, Ferran Duguid, said in a corridor conversation that he had heard from someone at the authority that the application was basically approved.
Ferran Duguid did not name the person, produce a document, an email, or a case reference number.
Marisol has not independently verified anything Ferran said and has no other source.
Q1 flight planning on the Threadneedle corridor cannot begin without a written decision.
Ines will restate Marisol's wording to investors on 5 December.
